chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq narrated to us, he said: Abu Sa'id al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Adawi narrated to us, he said: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Ammar al-Jarudi narrated to us, he said: Muhammad ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Abu al-Jarud, from Abu al-Haytham, from Anas ibn Malik, who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Indeed, God, Blessed and Exalted, will raise a group of people whose faces are of light, upon seats of light, wearing garments of light, in the shade of the Throne, at the rank of the prophets yet they are not prophets, and at the rank of the martyrs yet they are not martyrs.

So a man said: Am I from them, O Messenger of God? He said: No. Another said: Am I from them, O Messenger of God? He said: No. It was said: Who are they, O Messenger of God? He placed his hand upon the head of Ali (peace be upon him) and said: This one and his Shi'a.

key_terms.الأنبياء: Al-Anbiya' — The Prophets; those chosen by God to deliver His message
key_terms.الشهداء: Al-Shuhada' — The Martyrs; those who gave their lives for the cause of God
key_terms.العرش: Al-Arsh — The Throne of God; the greatest of created things, symbolizing divine sovereignty
key_terms.شيعة: Shi'a — Followers, partisans; here referring to the devoted followers of Imam Ali
key_terms.نور: Nur — Light; in Islamic theology, divine light symbolizing spiritual elevation and nearness to God

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali and his followers on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) described a distinguished group who will be raised on the Day of Judgment enveloped in light, seated on thrones of light under the shade of God's Throne, equal in rank to prophets and martyrs. When companions eagerly asked whether they were among them, the Prophet revealed through a powerful physical gesture — placing his hand on Imam Ali's head — that this honor belongs to Ali and his followers (Shi'a). This hadith, narrated by the companion Anas ibn Malik, was understood by its original audience as a definitive endorsement of devotion to Ali and his progeny.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq narrated to us. He said: Abu Sa`id al-Hasan b. `Ali al-Aduwi narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. `Abdullah b. `Ammar al-Jarudi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Abdullah narrated to us from Abi’l Jarud from Abi’l Haytham from Anas b. Malik.  He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

Allah will raise a group of people with faces of light, upon seats of light, wearing garments of light, in the shade of the Throne, at the rank of the prophets – and they are not prophets; and at the rank of the martyrs – and they are not martyrs.

So, a man said: Am I from them, O Messenger of Allah? He said: No. Another said: Am I from them, O Messenger of Allah? He said: No. It was said: Who are they, O Messenger of Allah? So, he placed his hand upon the head of `Ali (as) and said: Him and his Shi`a.
